name: bridge0
js: const S=__bw.battle.session, sim=S.sim; S.started=true; const g=S.sim.base.deploy; const keep=sim.buildings.find(b=>b.type==='keep'); for(const t of S.types){ const u=sim.units.find(x=>x.type===t); if(u&&u.air) continue; sim.send(t, keep.x, keep.z); } const br=[126,63]; S.cam.tx=br[0]; S.cam.tz=br[1]; S.cam.dist=75; S.cam.az=S.cam.az0; S.cam.pitch=0.9; let ids=new Map(); for(let i=0;i<150;i++){ sim.step(0.1); } const near=sim.units.filter(u=>!u.dead&&!u.air&&Math.hypot(u.x-br[0],u.z-br[1])<24); return {t:sim.time|0, near:near.length, onBr:near.filter(u=>Math.hypot(u.x-br[0],u.z-br[1])<10).length, types:near.reduce((a,u)=>(a[u.type]=(a[u.type]||0)+1,a),{})};

name: bridge1
js: const S=__bw.battle.session, sim=S.sim; const br=[126,63]; const pos0=new Map(sim.units.map(u=>[u.id,[u.x,u.z]])); for(let i=0;i<100;i++) sim.step(0.1); const near=sim.units.filter(u=>!u.dead&&!u.air&&Math.hypot(u.x-br[0],u.z-br[1])<22); const moved=near.map(u=>{const p=pos0.get(u.id); return Math.hypot(u.x-p[0],u.z-p[1]);}); return {t:sim.time|0, near:near.length, slow:moved.filter(m=>m<3).length, slowTypes:near.filter((u,i)=>moved[i]<3).map(u=>u.type+(u.target?'>'+u.target.type:'')+(u.stuck>1?'S':'')).join(','), alive:sim.units.filter(u=>!u.dead).length};

name: bridge2
js: const S=__bw.battle.session, sim=S.sim; for(let i=0;i<150;i++) sim.step(0.1); const br=[126,63]; const near=sim.units.filter(u=>!u.dead&&!u.air&&Math.hypot(u.x-br[0],u.z-br[1])<22); return {t:sim.time|0, near:near.length, det:near.map(u=>u.type+(u.target?'>'+u.target.type:'-')+((u.stuck||0)>1?'S':'')).join(',')};
